homepageTopArticles.title: LVMH Australia increases dividend despite sales decline
homepageTopArticles.snippet: The Australian branch of luxury juggernaut Louis Vuitton Moët Hennessy (LVMH) has increased the dividend payment to its parent company by more than a fifth.
